About:

James reveals exactly how he built a profitable Amazon FBA business from scratch, earning over $30,000 in his first year selling on Amazon. In this complete Amazon FBA tutorial, James shares his entire Amazon selling journey, from his first product idea being banned from Amazon advertising to launching a successful golf-themed drinking game called "Bogies and Beers" that now generates $4,000 to $6,000 per month in passive income.

In this Amazon FBA step-by-step guide, James breaks down the seven-step process for starting an Amazon business with no prior experience:

• Finding profitable product ideas by solving real problems in your own life using the passion product method
• Using Helium 10 for Amazon product research to validate demand and keyword search volume
• Conducting keyword research to rank high in Amazon search results and drive organic traffic
• Setting up your Amazon Seller Central account and choosing between FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant)
• Creating an LLC to protect your Amazon business and separate personal liability
• Building a premium brand with professional design, logos, and packaging that stands out
• Finding reliable manufacturers on Alibaba, ThomasNet, or Google to produce your products
• Creating and optimizing your Amazon listing with high-quality images, compelling bullet points, and keyword-rich descriptions
• Shipping products to Amazon FBA warehouses and printing FNSKU barcodes correctly
• Launching your Amazon product successfully by driving early sales through Facebook launch groups and Amazon PPC advertising campaigns

James shows how anyone can start selling on Amazon FBA in 2026, even with a small budget and zero experience. James shares his real story of being laid off during COVID and turning a bachelor party idea into a thriving Amazon private label brand. This complete Amazon FBA tutorial for beginners covers everything from Amazon product research using Helium 10, to Amazon listing optimization, to Amazon PPC ads strategy for anyone looking to create passive income on Amazon and build a profitable online business selling on Amazon.
